actionRequirement.description: The action requirement for the tool.

allowCrossRuntimeCalls.description:
If this is set to true, then the tool will allow cross-runtime calls.
By default, cross-runtime calls will not be attempted, and instead a
runtime error will be raised.
If this is set to true, then the tool creator should ensure that the
inputs/outputs of the tool are serializable/non-native values.
